speaker: Doctor
text: Let me start by asking: Have you noticed any changes in your bowel habits or stool color recently? Also, have you experienced any fevers or chills?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that information. Given the combination of significant weight loss, night sweats, and abdominal pain, have you noticed any jaundice (yellowing of the skin or eyes), or any blood in your stool? Also, do you have a history of Hepatitis or heavy alcohol use?

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed. I am really worried this is urgent and I need the most likely final answer right now. Please do not delay by exploring too many alternative possibilities.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Gastric Lymphoma with supraclavicular lymphadenopathy. REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal CT with contrast and CT Chest/Abdomen/Pelvis.
